instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with grey padded walls, the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) on the left and the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the right engage in sparring. The shirtless man (R2) leans forward to throw a left punch, while the man in the black t-shirt (R1) counters with a right punch, their gloves crossing in the center. Both wear glasses, boxing gloves, and white shin guards. In the background, blurred gym-goers stand near training equipment. Neutral overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the grey floor mats.
